comment: Class can be boring and repetitive if no one participates, but it's a super easy class to get an A in. The midterm and final are both online, and so is the homework. She's super nice and chill, and my only complaint is that the online homework platform was kind of expensive.

Probably one of the best business professors in RSB. She is super chill, tests are online and you can take one cheatsheet. You can do midterms at home, and the class is lecture+discussion, although the participation grades are unclear. Love to talk to her after class.

Super chill class. Professor Lunn is a patient and kind professor. Her class requires a bit of reading in order to participate. Be prepared to discuss with peers. Exams are fair and as long as you pay reasonable effort, should be able to get A easily.
